Subject: MAP Draft: Vendor onboarding / procurement steps (Ariba/Coupa)

Hi Jamie / Acme procurement team,

Thanks again for the time today — great call. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the vendor onboarding / procurement milestone so we can keep momentum toward a July close. High-level recap and proposed next steps below.

Call recap (30 min):
- Acme evaluation: Redwood inference for low-latency internal inference across US regions.
- Procurement constraints: need vendor record in Coupa/Ariba, W-9, banking details, signed terms or PO.
- Target: onboarding + PO issuance by 2026-07-30 to start pilot in early August.

Attached: 20260705-Acme-MAP-draft.pdf (MAP with milestones, owners, and dates).

Proposed vendor onboarding milestones (vendor onboarding / procurement):
1) Acme creates vendor record in Coupa / Ariba and shares vendor ID or portal link.
   - Owner: Acme procurement (Jamie)
   - Target: 2026-07-12
   - Dependencies: Acme vendor form completion; Redwood sends W-9 + banking info
2) Redwood provides completed W-9 and banking details via secure upload / portal.
   - Owner: Redwood (Marissa)
   - Target: 2026-07-07
3) Acme returns vendor form and confirms vendor ID; procurement issues PO.
   - Owner: Acme procurement
   - Target: 2026-07-20
4) Redwood acknowledges PO, completes any tax/finance onboarding, and schedules pilot kickoff.
   - Owner: Redwood (Camila + Finance Ops)
   - Target: 2026-07-30

Open questions for Acme:
- Do you prefer Ariba or Coupa for vendor creation? If Coupa, can you send the supplier link or portal contact?
- Any specific ACH remit format or bank requirements?

Next steps / asks:
- Jamie: share vendor portal link or vendor ID by 2026-07-12.
- Marissa: upload Redwood W-9 + banking stub by 2026-07-07.
- I will loop legal for contract redlines and share the SOW/PO template.

If that timeline looks good, we can lock the MAP and track updates in the shared Drive link.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MAP Draft: Vendor onboarding / procurement steps (Ariba/Coupa)

Camila — thanks for the clear recap and MAP. A few clarifications from procurement: 

1) We use Coupa for vendor onboarding. I can create a supplier request but we need Redwood to complete our vendor form (attached) and provide a W-9 + bank details.
2) For banking, we need ABA routing + account number and bank letter if available. ACH is preferred; wire is an option but requires additional approvals.
3) PO lead time is typically 7 business days after vendor record is active and docs are submitted.

We prefer to hit the 2026-07-30 target. Two asks: can Redwood provide a PDF W-9 and a secure link for banking docs by 2026-07-07? Also please confirm the legal team availability for any contract redlines next week.

Thanks,
Jamie Liu
Senior Procurement Manager, Acme Corporation
jamie.liu@acme-corp.com
